selection.summary: Feature request: allow configurable non-admin groups to bypass maintenance mode. No repair was completed — all apply_edits attempts failed (old-text-not-unique / stale-edit-source), so the only change recorded was a single edit to src/middleware/maintenance.js adding a groups.isMemberOfAny(req.uid, meta.config.groupsExemptFromMaintenanceMode) bypass check plus the groups require; the remaining edits (defaults.json, admin settings controller/route, ACP template, language keys) were not applied. Evidence: h6/h31 current maintenance.js middleware and imports; h8/h30 settingsController.get/post pattern for rendering group pickers; h10 admin route registration point; h5/h25 advanced.tpl maintenance section needing the groupsExemptFromMaintenanceMode multi-select; h3/h4 en-GB/en-US language files needing maintenance-mode.exempt-groups key; h11 defaults.json precedent for exempt-group defaults; h9 post.tpl multi-select template pattern; h16/h13/h14 groups.isMemberOfAny usage, membership implementation, and rename handling to mirror the post-queue exempt-groups design.
